answer:
The city that holds the title of **most populous national capital** is **Tokyo, Japan**.  
Tokyo officially became Japan’s capital on **27 November 1869** (the day after Emperor Meiji officially moved his court from Kyoto and renamed Edo “Tokyo”).  

> *“Tokyo became Japan’s capital in 1869 after the Meiji Restoration.”* (Source: Wikipedia, “History of Tokyo”)  

> *“Tokyo has served as the capital of Japan since 1869.”* (Source: Britannica, “Tokyo”)

Thus, the year in which the most populous national capital (Tokyo) was established as a capital is **1869**.
